title: webauthn rate limiter lock().unwrap() in handler
description: webauthn.rs:41. `check_auth_begin_rate_limit()` uses `.lock().unwrap()` on `AUTH_BEGIN_RATE` Mutex. This is reachable from the unauthenticated POST `/oauth/authorize/webauthn/begin` endpoint. If the Mutex is poisoned (another thread panicked while holding the lock), this panics and takes down the request handler. All other Mutex locks in inbox.rs and webauthn.rs (lines 428, 485, 605) correctly use `.unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())`. This one missed the pattern.
